Player Home Low fidelity · round 1 of 3

Abbie's own room, open at the front like a dollhouse. Tap the backpack, a charm on the shelf, or something in the accessory nook. Mock data, no saves.

Welcome home, Abbie.

Tap the backpack on its hook, a glass dome on the shelf, or an accessory on the rail.

What is mocked

  • The earned charms on the shelf, the backpack contents and the owned accessories are demonstration data. Charm names and quests are the real ones from simulations/backpack.mjs; nothing here reads or writes her real inventory.
  • The backpack is her default bunny one (grape stripes, heart pocket) drawn flat. The real 3D model replaces it in round 2.
  • Accessories are stand-ins; the nook is a new idea, with no accessory system behind it yet.
  • Neighbouring homes (stacked, side by side) are future context only: not built.

Design card: she feels this is hers; the room shows what she did (dome charms, a bag by the bed), diegetic; nothing but the reading card is overlay; the whole game adapts when she comes home: lamp light warms and the music quiets.
